notes.title: Midnight Murder Club Full Release
notes.content:
Greetings, Wormwood Mansion guests and victims. We humbly bring you a swath of changes and additions with the full release update of Midnight Murder Club: Patch 2.000.001! If you recall the Roadmap to Release from our June patch, then you know we’re ecstatic to bring a new co-op PVE mode, some Wildcards updates, and Key Remapping as just the tip of the knife-berg (Editor’s Note: because our game has knives. You can also view our launch trailer here if you haven’t had a chance to watch it yet. After all, we’d rather save you the time of searching so that you can spend it wandering the halls in fear (laughter?), or trying to unlock a certain special, golden item.

Thank you for playing our game! We hope you enjoy these changes and we look forward to seeing all of you brave the mansion with your friends and soon-to-be-former friends.

notes.title: Midnight Murder Club 1.2 Update
notes.content:
Patch Notes:
Features:

New Wildcards
[list]
[*] Falling Chandelier – attach a chandelier to the ceiling that will fall on your enemies when they walk underneath it
[*] Flaming Skull – transform into a flaming, flying skull and hunt your enemies from the skies!
[*] Growing Glow Trail –We’ve updated Glowing Glow Trails so now they get longer with every kill
[*] Party Room – there ain’t no party like a Midnight Murder Party because the Midnight Murder Party don’t stop! Until everyone is dead. Then... Then it stops...
[*] Knives Only – by popular request, you gotta slash your enemies to bits
[*] Sound Blast: Jazz Club – every time you fire your gun it sounds like a high school band rehearsing
[*] Pinged to Death! – on a player’s death, a pinger goes off revealing the locations of everyone in the mansion
[*] Shrink Shot – get shot, get shrunk, get revenge 
[*] Gift from the Grave – when you die, you’ll get a little present that will give you a chance to catch up and seek revenge
[*] All in the Chamber – all your bullets fire at once. More bullets = More good!
[/list]
Players can now play a Wildcards match with bots

Voice Scrambler: if you’re matched with someone who is being a bit of a jerk, you can now scramble their voice, so you can’t tell what they’re saying, but you can still tell where they are

Bots:
[list]
[*] Bots will now be better teammates
[*] Bots are now available in Wildcard matches
[/list]
Balancing:
[list]
[*] Mansion Compass – helps you navigate when your flashlight is on
[*] Death Pin Drops – players will now see a ping that shows them the location of where they last died in the mansion, helping them find their way back
[/list]
Other
[list]
[*] UI / UX flow updates to improve rematch capabilities and optimize grouping up with friends
[/list]
Known Issues
[list]
[*] Players using a controller on PC will not be able to navigate to the right-side menu after pressing “Play Game.” The current workaround if players need to access that menu is to use mouse and keyboard.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Launch Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Happy Early Access Launch Day![/h1]
Thank you for being part of our journey! The game is now available to download! Play a few rounds and let us know what you think! [url=http://www.discord.gg/velanstudios] Join our Discord[/url] to get the most up-to-date news, chat with the devs, and more.

Patch version 1.000.003 | Released: 3/13/25

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[b]Wildcards Game Mode[/b]
In this brand new game mode, we’re breaking all the rules! Each player chooses a card to dynamically change the game. Will yours be a curse… or a blessing? Try out different combinations for unexpected results! Shrink everyone down to 50% of their size, add a bullet proof vest to the Toy Vendor, or set everyone on fire if they stand still during the match… just to name a few!

[b]Guest Pass Edition[/b]
Invite up to five of your friends to play Midnight Murder Club with you for no additional cost! Guest Pass Edition is a free* download that allows you to play all modes as often as you like, as long as you have a friend with the full edition hosting the lobby. Guest Pass players can play in private matches (With a paying host) or join matchmaking (with a paying host leading your party and being the one to join the matchmaking queue).
*You do need PS+ on PS5 to play, and there are some regions that can't list M-rating-equivalent downloads for free, so the cost legally has to be something like $0.25 or $1.00 or similar, but we're pricing it as low as we legally can in those regions.

[b]Free-for-All and Team Deathmatch Bots[/b]
Want to keep exploring the mansion's shadows after your game night is over? Consider bots your fill-in friends when your entire party just can’t make it.  

[b]Rematch[/b]
Get matched with some foes that keep you on your toes, and find yourself with a beef that can only be settled with another match? Now, in public matchmaking, bring the whole group back for another round… and another… and another…

[b]Localization Support[/b]
English, German, French, Italian, EU Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, LATAM Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, and Korean

This is just the start, but we’ve got lots more in store! Here’s what you can expect from us in upcoming patches!

notes.title: 'The point is to be generous': This $20 FPS releasing next month is trying something new—giving away a full version of the game
notes.content: When a trailer for Midnight Murder Club, a lights-out multiplayer party shooter, aired at The Game Awards last December, I clocked the developer logo immediately. It was Velan Studios, the folks behind the dodgeball brawler Knockout City. That game was excellent, but like so many live service games that cultivate a modest audience, it died an early death in 2023. The experience had me reflexively worried for Midnight Murder Club, another multiplayer-only game—was Velan going down the same free-to-play road hoping that more people buy skins and battle passes this time?.. Read more.

notes.title: Midnight Murder Club adds Guest Pass and Wildcards mode
notes.content:
Welcome back to the [i]Midnight Murder Club[/i]. Here at Velan Studios, we’ve been toiling away in the shadowy halls of Wormwood Manor, coming up with fresh, new ways for you to hunt your friends in the darkness. We’ve got a new game mode to announce and an exciting new way to get your friends in on the fighting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074837/f0d8b31076a2573abb59d3a95650b99ab166c287.png[/img]

Midnight Murder Club is a first-person shooter/party game where you and five friends hunt each other in the pitch-black rooms of the mysterious Wormwood Manor.* Armed with only a revolver and a flashlight, search the shadows for every flicker of light and every bump in the night as you stalk your prey. The tension turns to hilarity as you discover just how tricky it is to navigate and shoot in complete darkness! You sprint toward your friends' shouting voices echoing through the mansion, only to bump into someone else hiding in a dark corner! Shots ring out, luring the other hunters to your location. Every flash of light is the promise of a deadly firefight. This is [i]Midnight Murder Club[/i].

[b]New Game Mode: Wildcards[/b]

On top of the existing Free for All, Thief in the Night, Team Deathmatch, and Headhunters modes, we’re excited to introduce a brand-new mode that lets you break the rules like never before! In the new [b]Wildcards[/b] game mode, players will play cards from their collection that change the rules for everyone in-game in wild new ways! From hijacking the toys that appear in vendors, to giving everyone super speed, to exploding into flames when you die—use these cards to show your wild side! Then, when the dust settles and the match is over, you’ll be gifted brand new cards to add to your collection giving you even more ways to change the game. In the new Wildcards game mode, it looks like chaos is in the cards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074837/3c1b4d812fa46dae80dd957e346f189c9b2969d5.png[/img]

[b]Play at no additional cost with the Midnight Murder Club Guest Pass Edition![/b]

We know that playing with friends is the best way to play any game and with the [i]Midnight Murder Club Guest Pass Edition[/i], it’s easier than ever! [i]Midnight Murder Club Guest Pass Edition[/i] allows your friends to join your game and play for no additional cost!

To put it simply: If one person buys the game, they can invite up to five Guest Pass Edition players to play [u]together[/u] for [b]no additional cost[/b] in public or private matches, in all current game modes, as much as you want.

We're really excited about the Guest Pass Edition because Midnight Murder Club is the perfect party game to play with friends. Now players can simply invite their friends into the club and let the mayhem begin. 

[b]Burning the Midnight Oil[/b]

To sum it up, we’re adding the brand-new Wildcards game mode and introducing a brand-new way to play with friends with the Guest Pass Edition. That’s a lot of new development work! Because of that, we’re going to need a little more time, so we’re pushing our Early Access launch date to March 13th, 2025. The full version of the game will be available for $19.99 (or equivalent in your region), and the Guest Pass Edition will be launching on the same day for no additional cost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074837/34226e91db297356e7ff4e8de85ccd5786663638.png[/img]

As a member of the [i]Midnight Murder Club[/i], your opinion on the direction the club should go matters! We’re really excited about evolving this game with the community as we continue developing through Early Access. We want your opinions and ideas, which will help shape our roadmap (which we’ll be sharing before launch!). Our [url=https://discord.gg/velanstudios]Discord[/url], the Steam Community Hub, and our socials will be open for discussions, feedback, and updates directly from us!

With these major changes and much more to come, we can’t wait to dive back into the darkness and haunt the hallowed halls of the Wormwood manor with you. Prepare yourselves for Midnight Murder Club coming to Early Access on PlayStation 5 and Steam on March 13th, 2025. 

See you in the shadows!

notes.title: Open Beta
notes.content:
[u][b]Most Noticeable/High Impact Issues[/b][/u]

Some users have experienced crashes when attempting to stream the game with OBS.

Some players will have trouble hearing their teammates on match results.

You will see an incorrect pop-up stating the host exited the game when you are disconnected from a match.

You may not be on the same team as the person you are grouped with.

Players can spawn close to each other in Free For All.

Voice Chat cuts out on the How To Play screen. Voice Chat should recover when users enter the game.
When a group member leaves an active match, the entire group will be removed from the active match.

[b]Gameplay[/b]

There are a few issues with spawning.

Hunted will spawn inside each other if they are killed around the same time. This is a visual only issue, and shouldn’t negative impact gameplay.

Players can spawn directly into bear traps, molotov flames and other toys/items.

Molotov VFX can be seen on first floor ceiling if thrower is on the second floor

Second toy can be spawned over the first toy on a toy vendor machine

An eliminated Hunter drops a Molotov that other Hunters cannot pickup

Voice chat can cut out when changing rooms or opening doors.

[b]UI[/b]

Control diagrams in game don't reference how to drop an item. Users can drop items by hitting the 123 keys on keyboard or hitting right left and down on the D-Pad for controller.

Rarely, player team UI can be scrambled at the beginning of a match.

Users can move their character while the game is paused. 

Compass appears blurry and very hard to read on lower resolutions

Some UI elements are missing on the main menu for group members.

Some player actions/events can still occur while on the match results screen.

The match results score can live update after match has completed

Nameplates above in game characters can be seen on the results screen when a match ends. If the user rotates their camera, they can see their teammate’s nameplate overlap with the match results content.

Currently the UI does not handle or account for ties. In a tie scenario, the player that last got a kill will be declared the winner.

[b]Performance[/b]

Some items and locations can cause performance issues on lower spec machines.

[b]Character[/b]

There are some visual issues with the shooting animations for both the revolver and the machine gun.

[b]Mansion[/b]

Placeholder pedestals appear throughout the mansion. These pedestals do not have collision.

One of the stair room names is not final and is still being determined. This will appear as TBD Stair Room below your compass when in this room.

notes.title: Midnight Murder Club - Open Beta
notes.content:
With a dusty creak, the wooden doors to Wormwood Manor swing open for our first open beta!

Hide, seek, and shoot in the dark with your friends across two of the four game modes that will be available when the game launches later this year:

Free-for-all - Six people enter, only one can emerge victorious. It's every player for themselves in a game of wits and stealth in the mansion's dark hallways.

Head Hunters - Four Hunted players race to find and destroy the totems hidden in the mansion before the two Hunted players can stop them. The only problem: The hunted have night vision and unlimited molotov cocktails at their disposal.

[url=https://discord.gg/velanstudios]Join our Discord[/url] to chat with other players about the game, share feedback with the dev team, and stay up-to-date on any game announcements over the course of the beta!

notes.title: Beta Preview Stream
notes.content:
We've taken feedback from the closed alpha last month and continued working on the game, and we're just about ready to open Wormwood Manor's doors to the public for this weekend's beta test.

Before we do, join us for a sneak peek at the beta you'll be able to get your hands on starting Thursday August 22nd.

Not signed up for the beta yet? Request access to the playtest on the game's Steam page below!

notes.title: Midnight Murder Club Playtest - Starting August 22nd
notes.content:
Miss our Closed Alpha last month? We're only a couple weeks away from inviting people back into the pitch-black mansion to experience the hilarious horrors of Midnight Murder Club.

Request Access on the store page to sign up. We'll be giving people access starting August 22nd, with the playtest running until August 26th, 2024.

notes.title: Midnight Murder Club - Closed Alpha
notes.content: Two weeks after announcing Midnight Murder Club, we're inviting people inside the mansion for the first time. Armed with only a flashlight, a revolver, and your wits, experience a hide and seek playground in the dark with your friends.
